strings.210-ФЗ статья 7 Сведения принёс сам заяв: 210-FZ Article 7 The applicant brought the information voluntarily
strings.210-ФЗ, статья 11.2, часть 6. Срок рассм: Law No. 210-ФЗ, Article 11.2, part 6. The complaint consideration period; sending the reasoned reply has a separate deadline.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.В вымышленном деле гражданин добровольно: In this fictional case, the citizen voluntarily submitted a proper document among those obtained through inter-agency channels. The selected service's rules permit this. The authority's employee refused solely because the information could be obtained without the applicant; no other grounds are established.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В материалах указано только наличие межв: The materials cite only the existence of inter-agency exchange; the document is proper.
strings.В орган, предоставляющий услугу; МФЦ в э: To the service authority; the MFC did not participate in this acceptance.
strings.Ввести для всех обязанность самостоятель: Introduce an obligation for everyone to obtain and bring this certificate themselves.
strings.Вы работаете в подразделении, обеспечива: You work in the unit supporting consideration of a complaint by the proper recipient. Prepare materials and a draft reasoned decision; do not assume the powers of the body providing the service. The case documents determine the specific recipient. This training service applies Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ; no other special federal procedure is specified.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Да. Учебные условия допускают его добров: Yes. The training conditions allow voluntary submission.
strings.Добровольное представление и обязательно: Voluntary submission and a mandatory requirement have different legal consequences.
strings.Добровольность отличается от обязательно: Voluntary submission differs from a mandatory requirement.
strings.Документ включён в круг межведомственных: Is the document within the scope of inter-agency information?
strings.Досудебная жалоба по главе 2.1 закона №: Pre-trial complaint under Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ
strings.Единый тридцатидневный порядок независим: A uniform thirty-day procedure regardless of subject matter
strings.Есть ли иная причина отказа?: Is there another reason for refusal?
strings.Запрет требовать межведомственный докуме: A prohibition on demanding an inter-agency document is not a prohibition on accepting it at the applicant's initiative.
strings.Запретить всем заявителям добровольно пр: Prohibit all applicants from voluntarily submitting information.
strings.Заявителя не заставляют собирать справку: The applicant is not being forced to obtain the certificate: they offer an admissible document voluntarily; refusing to accept it calls for a different decision.
strings.Исправить превращение добровольного спос: Correct the conversion of a voluntary option into an obligation and retain the possibility of inter-agency retrieval.
strings.Какая характеристика представления меняе: Which characteristic of the submission changes the conclusion?
Which characteristic of the submission changes the conclusion? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения жалобы на отка: Final day for reviewing the complaint about refusal to accept
strings.Куда вы принесли документ?: Where did you bring the document?
strings.Любой добровольный документ нужно вернут: Every voluntarily submitted document must be returned.
strings.Межведомственный обмен делает любое добр: Inter-agency exchange makes any voluntary submission unlawful.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью об ограничениях на истреб: Find the article limiting document demands and specifying permitted submission methods. Calculate the complaint period separately.
strings.Направить жалобу руководителю МФЦ, котор: Send the complaint to the director of an MFC that did not participate in this acceptance.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Немедленное удовлетворение любого требов: Immediate satisfaction of every demand without verification
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Отказали в его приёме, не рассматривая д: They refused to accept it without examining its validity. The refusal is documented.
strings.Отказать повторно только из-за наличия м: Refuse again solely because inter-agency exchange exists
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Подготовить оценку отказа по соответству: Prepare an assessment of the refusal under the relevant procedure
strings.Подготовить рассмотрение жалобы уполномо: Prepare review by an authorised person at the service authority of the complaint against refusal to accept a voluntarily submitted document.
strings.Помощник: «Нельзя требовать» означает «н: Assistant: “Must not demand” means “must not accept”.
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
The subject is refusal to accept the document.
strings.Приём добровольной справки позволяет сде: Accepting a voluntary certificate allows it to be made mandatory for subsequent applicants.
strings.Приём проводил орган, предоставляющий ус: Acceptance was handled by the service authority, not an MFC employee. That authority registered the complaint; no special federal procedure outside Chapter 2.1 applies.
strings.Проверить принятие материала и сохранени: Check acceptance of the material and retention of the inter-agency route for other cases
strings.Проверить, что документ надлежащий и доп: Check that the document is proper and voluntary submission is permitted
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Разъяснить право представить сведения по: Explain the right to submit information voluntarily without turning it into an obligation
strings.Рассмотреть отказ в приёме надлежащего д: Review the refusal to accept a proper voluntarily submitted document without making it mandatory.

Review the refusal to accept a proper voluntarily submitted document, without making it mandatory. The applicant is not being forced to obtain a certificate: they offer an admissible document themselves, so refusal to accept it requires a different decision.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сведения принёс сам заявитель · проверка: The applicant brought the information voluntarily · checking the basis
strings.Сверить предмет отказа и место приёма: Check what was refused and where acceptance took place
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Согласовать памятку, потому что так мень: Approve the guidance because it means less work for the authority.
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Справка не обязательна: орган может запр: The certificate is not mandatory: the authority can request it itself. I had already obtained it and brought it voluntarily. The authority's reception office said that because inter-agency exchange exists, they have no right to accept my document at all.
strings.Статья 7 закона № 210-ФЗ различает требо: Article 7 of Law No. 210-ФЗ distinguishes requiring interagency information from the option to supply it voluntarily. The case conditions confirm that the voluntarily supplied document is permissible and in proper form.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
strings.Требовать такую справку у всех заявителе: Require this certificate from all applicants after upholding the complaint
strings.Устанавливается надлежащий адресат жалоб: The proper complaint addressee is established.
strings.Участник вымышленной учебной ситуации: Participant in a fictional training situation
strings.Учебное продолжение. Документ приняли, н: Training continuation. The document was accepted, but the updated guidance calls it mandatory for everyone.
